## What it is

Partie haute de l'ancien `boitier_int`, bac brut. Face sud prolongée jusqu'à x = 120 (plus de canal 10 mm). Décrochage 5 mm sur la face sud, à l'est du DC (x = 55), pas un tenon dans le DC. Un puits d'aimant dans la baie est. Pas d'entretoises, pas de plateforme Wago, pas de passages.

## Design notes

Printed floor on the bed. Bbox 108 × 40 × 10 mm (x = 12–120, y = 55–95 with the south step). South face at y = 60 from x = 12 to x = 120, plus a 5×5 palier at (55, 55) — east of DC's east face at x = 55, so the two do not overlap. East of x = 85 the north stays at y = 85 (10 mm under y_max). One standing well centred in the east bay.

Polish 1 mm on convex verticals only. `min_wall = 0.6` is the magnet floor. The rectangle tray (110 × 45, réglettes, ouverture) is retired.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 0.6
```

## Don't

- Do not put the south step at x = 50: that sat in DC's corner and blocked the east-face component.
- Do not restore the 10 mm gutter: the south face runs to x = 120 at `aile_y`.
- Do not restore the seven M2 spacers or the Wago platform.
- Do not restore the rectangle AC tray (réglettes, ouverture, triangle).
- Do not fill the 10 mm gap under y_max east of x = 85: that clearance is the machine.
- Do not add linking notches or passages between the boxes yet.
